item.title: Ulhasnagar Municipal Corporation Result: BJP leads in five of 78 seats, others in two
item.description: The election in Ulhasnagar took place on January 15.

item.title: Sanjay Raut on BMC results as BJP takes huge lead: 'We have assured people not to be afraid'
item.description: Sanjay Raut said the exit polls arrived even before the voting percentage and the BJP started celebrating its victory but his party has assured the people not to be afraid.

item.title: Chandrapur Municipal Corporation Election Results 2026: BJP, Shiv Sena-UBT locked in close contest
item.description: Early trends from the Chandrapur civic vote count show BJP and Shiv Sena-UBT in a close contest, with counting still in progress.

item.title: Yashant Varma suffers stepback as Supreme Court rejects plea against Parliamentary panel
item.description: Justice Varma was transferred from the Delhi High Court back to the Allahabad High Court after burnt wads of currency notes were discovered at his official residence in New Delhi on March 14.

item.title: Windows 10 and Windows 11 users are facing new security vulnerability: CERT-In Issues Security Alert
item.description: The Indian government has issued a cybersecurity alert for Windows 10 and Windows 11 users after identifying a vulnerability in Microsoft’s Desktop Window Manager. CERT-In has advised users and organisations to install the latest security updates to prevent sensitive data exposure.

item.title: Aurangabad Municipal Corporation Results 2026: BJP leads with 12 seats, Shiv Sena, AIMIM at 5 each
item.description: Early trends in the Aurangabad (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar) Municipal Corporation elections show the BJP leading with 12 seats. Shiv Sena and AIMIM are ahead in 5 seats each, while Congress and Shiv Sena (UBT) are leading in 3 seats each.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi's first reaction amid BMC vote counting: 'Vote Chori is an anti-national act'
item.description: Rahul Gandhi has strongly criticised the Election Commission as Mahayuti takes commanding leads in the Maharashtra municipal polls. His comment on collapsing democratic trust fuels a major political debate while counting continues statewide.

item.title: Bangladesh cricketers call off boycott, BPL expected to resume after delay
item.description: The Bangladesh cricketers have called off their boycott of the BPL (Bangladesh Premier League) after BCB director Nazmul Islam was sacked from the finance committee after his recent comments against the players.

item.title: Akola Municipal Corporation Election Result LIVE: Neck-and-neck fight between BJP and Congress
item.description: The Akola Municipal Corporation, which governs the city in Maharashtra, has a total of 80 seats. The civic body is responsible for key urban issues including water supply, sanitation, road maintenance, and infrastructure development.
